October 14, 2025                            Buildings Bulletin 2025-005




      RELATED CODE SECTIONS & RESOURCES
      New York State Multiple Dwelling Law Article 7-C Legalization of Interim
      Multiple Dwellings (NYS MDL 7-C §281), Buildings Bulletin 2025-005


 I. PROFESSIONALLY CERTIFIED LOFT BOARD COMPLIANCE APPLICATIONS
    Buildings Bulletin 2025-005 (BB2025-005) describes the criteria for participation in the Department’s
    Professional Certification Program, and effective July 2025, prohibits the professional certification filing of
    Loft Board compliance applications.

    For the purposes of BB2025-005, Loft Board compliance applications shall mean the alteration application
    to obtain a residential certificate of occupancy in accordance with New York State Multiple Dwelling Law
    (NYS MDL) Article 7-C for the Legalization of Interim Multiple Dwellings (IMD) registered with the NYC Loft
    Board, and all other applications that are related to the work needed to achieve compliance with NYS MDL
    Article 7-C.

    Applications for work in an IMD, as defined by the NYS MDL §281, that are not related to the work for
    compliance with MDL Article 7-C may continue to be professionally certified. The Executive Director of the
    Loft Board shall determine if an application is related to the subject work.


 II. RELATED REFERENCE MATERIAL
